title: ADAC Camping / Stellplatz 2023
meta_description: Simply find the perfect campsite or parking space - Incl. ADAC Campcard 2023
full_description: Promotional price until January 31, 2023: €5.99 (instead of €9.99)---App Version 0.9 - For all campers who are already planning for the next season, the fully functional beta version of our new app. A few small details are currently being optimized. The update with the finished version 1.0 will appear shortly. Have fun with the planning!---New 2023:+ Availability and real-time price information for approx. 3,000 campsites with booking directly via PiNCAMP+ Attractive ADAC Campcard offers: at least 15% up to 50% discount+ Current information on over 22,000 campsites and parking spaces throughout EuropeSerious, reliable, up-to-date: The ADAC is the perfect companion for your camping holiday. In the ADAC camping and parking space app you will find detailed information on over 12,000 campsites and over 9,000 parking spaces in Germany and throughout Europe.All highlights of the app at a glance:+ Digital discount card ADAC Campcard included+ Simple registration of the digital ADAC Campcard directly via the main menu in the app+ Search for available campsites on your travel date and book directly+ Combined universal search (text, equipment and map)+ Extensive filter options for quickly finding a place+ Favorites function including personal notes+ Offline operation: The favorites function as well as images, descriptions and facilities of places can also be used without an internet connection+ Direct connection to installed navigation apps, e.g. the ADAC fuel prices and navigation app with live fuel prices and optimized routes for mobile homes and trailers.+ Google Drive support for data transfer and device synchronizationAll important details at a glance: Always make the right choice thanks to ADAC classification and camper ratings.The ADAC classification objectively assesses the quality and facilities of campsites and motorhome parking spaces using a system that is standardized throughout Europe. The ADAC classification is made up of results in the categories of sanitation, space, supply, leisure and bathing facilities and is given as a rating from 1 to 5 stars.In addition, the app contains more than 60,000 personal testimonials from other campers as an ideal supplement to the ADAC classification. With the help of both ratings, the next dream spot can be found in no time at all.Better than ever: The digital ADAC Campcard 2023Saving money has never been easier! For the first time, campsites participating in the Campcard are offering a discount of at least 15% and up to 50% on at least 50 days a year. The discount is generally granted on the overnight price for the stand and any additional personal fees that may be incurred. In addition, numerous campsites offer during the discount period that children up to the age of 6 years and dogs can stay overnight free of charge. The ADAC Campcard is always valid for the specified calendar year and is valid until January 31 of the following year.---+ The app is only available in German.+ Purchases made through Google Play/Google Commerce Limited are a one-time license fee for the output of the specified calendar year.+ All updates within the specified calendar year are included.+ It is not a subscription, there will be no renewed debiting, a termination is not necessary.+ After the end of the specified calendar year, the app can still be used.+ The technical functionality of the app is guaranteed until the end of the following year, as long as this is within the sphere of influence of ADAC Camping GmbH. It is possible that the app or individual functions may no longer be fully functional afterwards.+ For unrestricted use, including the latest data beyond the calendar year, as well as access to the advantages of the ADAC Campcard, the annual purchase of the subsequent edition is necessary.
